sanskrit: sāvīr hi deva prathamāya pitre varṣmāṇam asmai varimāṇam asmai | athāsmabhyaṃ savitar vāryāṇi dvedve ā suvā bhūri paśvaḥ ||
english: For you, O god, have set forth for the primal Father his full stature and his breadth. Now, O Savitṛ, press out for us desirable gifts twofold, along with abundant cattle.

sanskrit: bhadrād adhi śreyaḥ prehi bṛhaspatiḥ puraetā te astu | athemam asyā vara ā pṛthivyā āreśatruṃ kṛṇuhi sarvavīram ||
english: Go forward from the good to the better; let Bṛhaspati be your forerunner. Then make this man, in the choicest part of this earth, one who has driven off enemies, possessed of all heroic men.

sanskrit: damūnā devaḥ savitā vareṇyo dadhad ratnaṃ dakṣaṃ pitṛbhya āyūṃṣi | pibāt somaṃ mamadad enam iṣṭe parijmā cid ramate asya dharmaṇi ||
english: The god Savitṛ, dwelling in the house, most excellent, bestowing wealth, vigor, and long lives upon the fathers — may he drink soma, may he exhilarate this man at the sacrifice; even the wide-roaming one delights in his holy ordinance.

sanskrit: tāṃ savituḥ satyasavasya citrāṃ vayaṃ devasya prasave vanāmahe | yām asya kaṇvo aduhat prapīnāṃ sahasradhārāṃ mahiṣo bharāya ||
english: That brilliant gift of Savitṛ of true might, of the god, at his impulsion, do we win — that which Kaṇva milked for the great bull, the full-uddered cow of thousandfold streams, for the sustaining.

sanskrit: ko no asyā druho 'vadyavatyā un neṣati kṣatriyo vasya icchan | kaḥ pūrtikāmaḥ ka u yajñakāmaḥ ko deveṣu vanute dīrgham āyuḥ ||
english: Who among the nobles, desiring better fortune, will lead us out of this blameworthy hostility? Who desires the fulfillment of vows? Who desires sacrifice? Who wins long life among the gods?

sanskrit: kaḥ pṛśniṃ dhenuṃ varuṇena dattām atharvaṇe sudughāṃ nityavatsām | tāṃ bṛhaspatyā sakhyā duhāno yathāvaśaṃ tanvaḥ kalpayāti ||
english: Who, milking by friendship with Bṛhaspati the dappled cow given by Varuṇa to the Atharvan — easy to milk, ever with her calf — shall make the body prosper according to his will?

sanskrit: na ghraṃs tatāpa na himo jaghāna pra sarsṛte pṛthivī jīradānuḥ | āpaś cid asmai sadam it kṣaranti yatra somaḥ sadam it tatra bhadram ||
english: Heat has not scorched him, nor has cold struck him down; the earth, the swift-flowing, streams forth for him. Even the waters flow for him unceasingly; where soma is, there is blessing evermore.

sanskrit: yasyā idaṃ pradiśi yad virocate anumatiṃ prati bhūṣanty āyavaḥ | yasyā upastha urv antarikṣaṃ sā naḥ śarma bahulaṃ ni yacchāt ||
english: In whose quarter of the sky this shines forth, toward Anumati do the descendants adorn themselves; whose lap is the wide atmosphere — may she grant us abundant shelter.

sanskrit: anv adya no anumatir yajñaṃ deveṣu yacchatām | agniś ca havyavāhano bhavatāṃ dāśuṣe mayaḥ ||
english: May Anumati today guide our sacrifice to the gods; may Agni, the carrier of oblations, be a source of joy for the one who has given.

sanskrit: anv id anumate tvaṃ maṃsase śaṃ ca nas kṛdhi | iṣaṃ tokāya no dadhaḥ pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣaḥ ||
english: For truly, O Anumati, you will consent; bring welfare to us. Bestow nourishment upon our offspring; extend our lifespans for us.

sanskrit: anu manyatām anumanyamānā prajāvatīṣam akṣīyamāṇam | tasyā vayaṃ heḍasi mā vi bhūma sā no devī suhavā śarma yacchatu ||
english: May the consenting Anumati consent — the nourishment rich in progeny, never diminishing. May we not fall into her wrath; may that goddess, easy to invoke, grant us shelter.

sanskrit: anumate anu manyasva tā no yā te vayaṃ cakṛmā yā tanūbhiḥ | yā tokeṣu tanuṣu yā prajāyāṃ yā goṣv oṣadhīṣv apsv antaḥ ||
english: O Anumati, consent to those deeds of ours — whatever we have done with our bodies; whatever has been done regarding offspring, regarding bodies, regarding progeny, among cattle, among herbs, within the waters.

sanskrit: ā no devy anumatir jagamyāt sukṣatratāvīratā yā sujātā | bhadrā hy asyāḥ pramatir babhūva semaṃ yajñam avatu devajuṣṭam ||
english: May divine Anumati, well-born, possessed of good dominion and heroic power, come to us. For her guidance has been benevolent; may she protect this sacrifice beloved by the gods.

sanskrit: anumatir viśvam idaṃ jajāna yad ejati carati yac ca tiṣṭhati | tasyās te devi sumatau syām- -ānumate anu hi maṃsase naḥ ||
english: Anumati begot all this — whatever trembles, whatever moves, and whatever stands still. May I be in the good grace of her, O goddess Anumati; for you, O Anumati, will indeed consent to us.

sanskrit: yat te nāma suhavaṃ supraṇīte anumate anumataṃ sudānu | tena tvaṃ sumatiṃ devy asmā iṣaṃ pinva viśvavāraṃ suvīram ||
english: By that name of yours which is easy to invoke, O well-guiding Anumati, agreed upon and good to bestow — by that name, O goddess, swell nourishment for us, all-desired and rich in heroes, with benevolent thought.

sanskrit: prajābhyas tvā prajās tvānu prāṇantu prajā anu prāṇihi | śukraṃ te śukreṇa candraṃ candreṇāmṛtam amṛtena krīṇāmi ||
english: I consecrate you for progeny; may progeny breathe after you; breathe life into the progeny. I buy your brightness with brightness, your radiance with radiance, your immortality with immortality.

sanskrit: tapasas tanūr asi prajāpater varṇaḥ | parameṇa paśunā krīyase ||
english: You are the body of austerity, the color of Prajāpati. You are purchased with the supreme sacrificial animal.

sanskrit: abhi tyaṃ devaṃ savitāram oṇyoḥ kavikratum | arcāmi satyasavaṃ ratnadhām abhi priyaṃ matim ||
english: I praise that god Savitṛ, of poet-wisdom, hidden within the two woolen strands, of true impulse, the bestower of gems, with a beloved thought.

sanskrit: ūrdhvā yasyāmatir bhā adidyutat savīmani | hiraṇyapāṇir amimīta sukratuḥ kṛpā svaḥ ||
english: He whose upward-shooting thought blazed with light at his impulsion — golden-handed and of excellent resolve, he measured out the sky with grace.

sanskrit: ayaṃ sahasramānṛṣiḥ kavīnāṃ matir jyotir vidharmaṇi | bradhnaḥ samīcīr uṣasaḥ sam īrayāt ||
english: This one, the thought of seers, measuring out a thousand, the light in the ordinance — may the radiant one drive together the meeting dawns.

sanskrit: arepasaḥ sacetasaḥ svasare manyumattamāḥ | cite goḥ ||
english: Sinless, like-minded, on the day of Svā, most full of spirit — at the recognition of the cow.

sanskrit: sam eta viśvā ojasā patiṃ divo ya eka id bhūr atithir janānām | sa pūrvyo nūtanam āvivāsan taṃ vartanir anu vavṛta ekam it puru ||
english: Come together, all, with might toward the lord of heaven, who alone has truly been the guest of peoples. That ancient one, making the new shine forth — the track has turned back around him alone, everywhere.

sanskrit: kuhūṃ devīm amṛtāṃ vidmanāpasam asmin yajñe suhavāṃ johavīmi | yā no dadāti śravaṇaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tasyai te devi haviṣā vidhema ||
english: I call with repeated invocation the divine Kuhū, the immortal, the skilled in work, the easy to invoke, in this sacrifice. She who gives us the hearing of the ancestors — to you, O goddess, we render worship with oblation.

sanskrit: kuhūr devānām amṛtasya patnī havyā no asya haviṣaḥ śṛṇotu | saṃ dāśuṣe kiratu bhūri puṣṭā rāyaspoṣaṃ cikituṣe dadhātu ||
english: May Kuhū, consort of immortality among the gods, hear our oblation of this offering. Abundantly nourished, may she pour forth blessings upon the one who gives; may she bestow flourishing of riches upon the wise one.

sanskrit: saṃ jānīdhvaṃ saṃ pṛcyadhvaṃ saṃ vo manāṃsi jānatām | mitro vaḥ sarvāḥ saṃ sṛjān mayi saṃjñānam astu vaḥ ||
english: Come to agreement together; come to union together; let your minds know one another. May Mitra unite all of you together; may there be concord among you with me.
